facility.name: Creating Little Scholars Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cleaning supplies were  stored in a cabinet above the hand washing sink in the school-age classroom. The cabinet does not have a lock to prevent access to children. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: An infant was combined with a child that was more than 18 months older than the youngest child in the group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the 6 children's records evaluated, 1 was behind with iummunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Of the 6 children's records evaluated, 2 lacked the address of the emergency contact. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Cleaning supplies were stored in a cabinet that was accessible to children. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Of the six children's records evaluated, four lacked a health statement listing the name and address of the doctor that has examined the child within the past year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: An infant was sitting in a seat without the safety straps being fastened.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A school-age child was left unsupervised in the hallway when the caregiver left to answer the front door. The same caregiver left her classroom of pre-school age children to open the front door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The children were watching television while eating breakfast.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Of the eight employee files evaluated, the following information was missing:  1. Two records lacked documentation of how the education requirement was met.  2. Six staff lacked a notarized affidavit.  3. One staff lacked a pre-employment affidavit
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies were reviewed and the following information was missing:  1. Illness and exclusion criteria  2. Suspension and expulsion policy  3. Safe sleep policy for infants under 12 months  4. Hearing and vision screening requirements  5. Transportation services  6. Water activities offered  7. Field trips offered  8. Parent's rights  9. Procedure for parent to discuss concerns with the director  10. Website for parents to review Minimum Standards  11. Emergency Preparedness Plan  12. Staff requirements for annual training in preventing and responding to abuse and neglect, procedures to increase parent  and staff awareness  regarding abuse and neglect along with prevention techniques, community organizations the center will work with and actions a parent of a child who is a victim of abuse should take to obtain assistance.  13, Staff vaccination policy.  14. Procedures to support inclusive services for children with special care needs.  15. Inform parents the center is in a gang free zone.  16. Benefits of outdoor play, duration of physical activity for all age groups, type of physical activity, setting of physical activity, recommended footwear and the criteria used when weather prevents outdoor activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Staff have not completed an orientation to the child care center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The center does not have a current health inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: The use zone for a piece of stationary equipment is not measuring 6 feet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: Three caregivers have not completed a pediatric CPR training course that meets the required guidelines of the American Heart Association.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Two caregiver have not completed eight clock hours of pre-service training prior to being counted in the child/staff ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The center does not have a current fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: One staff's foreign education documents have not been translated in English showing the education is equivalent to USA high school diploma.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1045)

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Of the six children's records evaluated, four lacked a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Of the 6 children's records evaluated, the following information was missing:  1. One record lacked telephone numbers for people that can pick the child up.  2. One record lacked the parent's phone number  3. One lacked the address for the emergency contact  4. One lacked the address and phone number for the emergency care facility listed.  5. One lacked information on special needs  6. One lacked information on water activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))
